GeneDef.label: Zoophagical obsession
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores having animals as prey. Never let it watch your pets.

GeneDef.label: Zoophagical taste
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes having animals as prey. It's what most sapient life's been doing already for thousands of years; why stop now, especially when they squirm so wildly?

GeneDef.label: Zoophagical ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't mind having animals as prey, but doesn't prefer them either.

GeneDef.label: Zoophagical distaste
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes having animals as prey. Maybe it can't bear to see its fuzzy friends imperiled, maybe it thinks cannibalism is the true way, maybe it just doesn't like to get dirt and fur all over its tongue.

GeneDef.label: Zoophagical revulsion
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates having animals as prey and will never willingly consume them. It would sooner hunt the beast down, skin it, butcher it, cook it, and eat it, all on its own, than swallow it whole.

GeneDef.label: Anthropophagical obsession (cannibal)
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores having its fellow sapient beings as prey; even fatally, as an extension of its cannibalistic tendencies. Humanoid meat tastes best alive and kicking.

GeneDef.label: Anthropophagical taste (cannibal)
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes having its fellow sapient beings as prey; even fatally, as an extension of its cannibalistic tendencies. People are tasty! And clean, usually.

GeneDef.label: Anthropophagical obsession (endo)
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores having its fellow sapient beings as prey, so long as it's safe. The dark side of vore does tempt it though, with all these delicious, filling preythings...

GeneDef.label: Anthropophagical taste (endo)
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes having its fellow sapient beings as prey, so long as it's safe. Fatal vore, on the other hand, is no different from regular old butcher-and-chew cannibalism.

GeneDef.label: Anthropophagical ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't mind having its fellow sapient beings as prey, fatal or otherwise, but doesn't prefer them either.

GeneDef.label: Anthropophagical distaste
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes having its fellow sapient beings as prey. Maybe it's too much like cannibalism; maybe it's self-conscious about its insides.

GeneDef.label: Anthropophagical revulsion
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates having its fellow sapient beings as prey and will never willingly consume them. It's a perversion of the natural order, cannibalistic or not.

GeneDef.label: Entomophagical obsession
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores having live bugs as prey. Its whole body may as well be a hive. Furthermore, its taste for chewing chitin extends to raw and cooked bug meat, too.

GeneDef.label: Entomophagical taste
GeneDef.description: This pawn enjoys having live bugs as prey. Its taste for chewing chitin extends to raw and cooked bug meat, too.

GeneDef.label: Entomophagical ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't mind having live bugs as prey, but doesn't prefer them either.

GeneDef.label: Entomophagical distaste
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes having live bugs as prey. It has a list of places bugs should not be, and one of those places is "alive and crawling around inside its body".

GeneDef.label: Entomophagical revulsion
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates having live bugs as prey and will never willingly consume them. The very thought makes its skin crawl.

GeneDef.label: Mechanophagical obsession
GeneDef.description: This pawn adores having mechanoids as prey. It has the munchies for metal, a taste for titanium and steel. That doesn't necessarily equate to the digestive strength to churn a mechanoid into food, but it's something.

GeneDef.label: Mechanophagical taste
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes having mechanoids as prey. It proves the flesh is stronger than the machine, or something. That doesn't necessarily equate to the digestive strength to churn a mechanoid into food, but it's something.

GeneDef.label: Mechanophagical ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't mind having mechanoids as prey, but doesn't prefer them either.

GeneDef.label: Mechanophagical distaste
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes having mechanoids as prey. They're cold and angry and don't exactly feel great to swallow.

GeneDef.label: Mechanophagical revulsion
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates having mechanoids as prey and will never willingly consume them. It absolutely does not want to put hundreds of angry pounds' worth of sharp edges, moving parts, and cold steel directly into its body.

GeneDef.label: Exclusive Gynophage
GeneDef.description: This pawn exclusively prefers female prey, and will never willingly eat a man.

GeneDef.label: Gynophagic Tendencies
GeneDef.description: This pawn prefers female prey, but may make occasional exceptions.

GeneDef.label: Gender Indifferent
GeneDef.description: The gender of their prey is not a consideration for this pawn. Prey is prey; doesn't matter what they look like.

GeneDef.label: Androphagic Tendencies
GeneDef.description: This pawn prefers male prey, but may make occasional exceptions.

GeneDef.label: Exclusive Androphage
GeneDef.description: This pawn exclusively prefers male prey, and will never willingly eat a woman.

GeneDef.label: Obsessive fondeur
GeneDef.description: As an obsessive fondeur, this pawn loves digestion and all manner of conversion into bodily fluids, to the neglect of other goals.

GeneDef.label: Fondeur
GeneDef.description: As a fondeur, this pawn likes the feeling of prey digesting into mush, or milk, or spunk, or what-have-you: to feel the struggle cease, and the hard lumps go soft.

GeneDef.label: Digestion ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about digesting prey.

GeneDef.label: Digestion aversion
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes digesting prey. It takes no enjoyment out of gurgling a life away and would rather its prey left intact.

GeneDef.label: Digestion disgust
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates digesting prey. What an act of unimaginable cruelty!

GeneDef.label: Obsessive plaire
GeneDef.description: This pawn loves to pleasure-vore prey. It seeks little else besides the usage of its body as an engine of pleasure.

GeneDef.label: Plaire
GeneDef.description: This pawn likes to pleasure-vore prey, with a sensual tour of its body.

GeneDef.label: Pleasure ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about pleasuring prey.

GeneDef.label: Chaste predator
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes pleasuring prey. Maybe it's squeamish about letting prey get lewd inside it; maybe it just doesn't enjoy it like prey do.

GeneDef.label: Celibate predator
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates pleasuring prey. Vore is not to be treated as a fancy sex position.

GeneDef.label: Geolier hoarder
GeneDef.description: As a geolier, this pawn loves to hold onto prey for as long as possible, and would be delighted to store as many people as can be fit inside of it forever.

GeneDef.label: Geolier
GeneDef.description: As a geolier, this pawn likes to hold onto prey for as long as possible. It would make a good jail cell.

GeneDef.label: Storage ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about storing prey.

GeneDef.label: Noncommittal pred
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes storing prey indefinitely. It doesn't want to be burdened by prey longer than it has to. Find someone else to be your warehouse.

GeneDef.label: In-and-out pred
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates storing prey indefinitely. Find someone else to be your warehouse.

GeneDef.label: Heavy Holder
GeneDef.description: As a heavy Holder, this pawn loves to allow its prey a trip through itself.

GeneDef.label: Holder
GeneDef.description: As a Holder, this pawn likes to pass their prey.

GeneDef.label: Hold ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about temporarily storing prey.

GeneDef.label: UnHoldy pred
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes temporarily storing prey.

GeneDef.label: Holding refusal
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates storing prey temporarily.

GeneDef.label: Heal Slut
GeneDef.description: No need to spam E, this pawn has got you covered with a cozy place to stay in and get healthy.

GeneDef.label: Healer
GeneDef.description: As a professional MMO Healer, this pawn likes to carry their team.

GeneDef.label: Heal ambivalence
GeneDef.description: This pawn doesn't really care one way or the other about healing prey.

GeneDef.label: Unhealthy pred
GeneDef.description: This pawn dislikes healing prey.

GeneDef.label: Healing refusal
GeneDef.description: This pawn hates healing prey.
